profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Wolfram Alpha, LLC
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer who is passionate about developing large, complex applications with almost 10 years of industry experience in management, project planning, collaboration, and building large applications.

I have helped develop Wolfram Alpha and paid premium features for Wolfram Alpha Pro, several payment solutions for Wolfram Research, a business-critical web application for a small aviation company, and a full featured web application for Habitat for Humanity.

Professionally, I have extensively used Java, JSP, JSTL, Spring, and MySQL and on the side, I have used ASP.NET, C#, and SQL Server.

company.name: Wolfram Research and Wolfram Alpha, LLC

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently the Manager of Web R&D Team

Formulate, supervise, and assist with the development of team’s core systems as business requirements evolve

Project: Subscription Billing System

Designed and developed a new multi-currency and multi-organization self-service billing system using the Stripe payment processor 

Collaborated with several groups to ensure new billing system integrates seamlessly with existing financial system and procedures

Designed and built a centralized system that utilizes multiple systems to streamline the resolution of subscription and billing issues by internal groups 

Created an automated system for processing time-consuming tasks such as billing operations

Migrated legacy data to new billing system to ensure uninterrupted service for existing customers

Project: Authentication System

Coordinate and supervise the development of the new OAuth authentication system that will eventually be used by all Wolfram sites to create a single sign on experience for users

Create an authentication system that can be used by our partners to integrate with our product and services

positions.title: Manager of Web Development
positions.description:
Prioritized and organized daily tasks for the Wolfram Alpha web development team

Supervised engineers in the development and release of paid premium features for Wolfram Alpha Pro

Trained interns and developers to understand the architecture of our systems

Maintained communication and priorities between the web development team and executives, business development, quality assurance, design, public relations, customer service, and other teams

Implemented a subscription billing service for Wolfram Alpha Pro that accepts credit card, PayPal, and Amazon Payments, providing Wolfram Alpha with its first self-service revenue stream

Partnered with customer service and finance to develop the tools, policies, and procedures for resolving subscription and billing issues while minimizing the number of people involved

Created a highly available system that persists authenticated users across a large distributed system

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Helped launch Wolfram Alpha, a natural language query engine for math and curated data sets such as weather, financials, science, and sports, which helps provide answers for Apple’s Siri

Built a portal for users to obtain and manage Wolfram Alpha API keys and interactive widgets

positions.title: Independent Web Consultant
positions.description:
Porting application to ASP.NET Web API and AngularJS for a faster, mobile-optimized user experience and migrating the site to a hosting service

Streamlined business-critical operations by replacing spreadsheets for managing flights, employees, aircrafts, maintenance schedules, and customers with a ASP.NET Web Forms and C# application backed by SQL Server

Defined the requirements in collaboration with the owners, created self-service forms, designed a large SQL database scheme, and performed maintenance as required

positions.description: Responsible for the development and maintenance of departmental web sites
